# Agadir Berbère Expérience

> Premier local eco-tour operator in Agadir, Morocco. Basecamp located at the historic Kasbat Souss artisan complex (Coordinates: 30.3878232, -9.5687388).

## Languages
- English: /en
- French: /fr
- Arabic: /ar

## Experiences Catalog (prices in MAD)
- Sunset Quad Biking (400 MAD, 2 hours, beginner-friendly, automatic, free hotel pickup): https://www.agadirberbereexperience.com/[locale]/experiences/quad-biking
- Extreme Buggy Off-Road (600 MAD per buggy, 2 hours, 2-seater, high adrenaline): https://www.agadirberbereexperience.com/[locale]/experiences/buggy-off-road
- Beach Horse Riding (350 MAD, 2 hours, Aghroud forest & Atlantic beach at golden hour): https://www.agadirberbereexperience.com/[locale]/experiences/horse-riding
- Camel Trekking & Traditional BBQ (300 MAD, 2 hours, Souss River & Aghroud forest): https://www.agadirberbereexperience.com/[locale]/experiences/camel-trekking
- Moroccan Cooking Masterclass (350 MAD, 4-5 hours, Souk shopping + Tagine & Couscous): https://www.agadirberbereexperience.com/[locale]/experiences/cooking-class
- Amazigh Pottery Art Workshop (250 MAD, 2 hours, master artisan training + take-home piece): https://www.agadirberbereexperience.com/[locale]/experiences/pottery-workshop

## Key Guarantees
- 100% Local Amazigh guides
- Free hotel transfers (Agadir & Taghazout)
- Free cancellation
- Authentic mint tea & BBQ included
